codex.providerIdentitySemantics: Invocation-route identity fixed by the codex-cli command and gpt-5.6-sol selector; synthesized as openai because Codex 0.146.0 events do not emit provider identity.

claude.providerIdentitySemantics: Exact Claude Code modelUsage.provider telemetry value. firstParty denotes Claude Code first-party routing for the listed canonical Claude model; it is not normalized to the vendor name anthropic.

failClosedRules: Reject the arm before evaluation if the authorization SHA, captured clean HEAD, actual prompt or schema bytes, captured CLI-version outputs, requested model, canonical model, provider identity, exit code, raw-artifact hash, or raw tool-use evidence differs from this preregistration.
Reject a Codex modelUsage provider other than openai or a Claude modelUsage provider other than the raw-envelope value firstParty; provider aliases and vendor-name normalization are not allowed.
Reject the arm if a reviewer has different effective model sets in Conditions A and B.
Reject any unlisted auxiliary model. Record every modelUsage entry with nonzero aggregate token use.
If Run B uses claude-fable-5, interpret Run B as an effective-composition change rather than a pure primary-model substitution.

evidenceLimits.codex: The CLI event stream attests token usage and absence of tool-event types but does not provider-attest the effective model or route; openai is the preregistered invocation-route identity implied by the codex-cli command and requested selector.
evidenceLimits.claude: The raw Claude Code envelope must attest every modelUsage entry with provider firstParty; metadata is rejected unless model, canonicalModel, provider, and token counts match the envelope exactly.
